card.name: Linking words in rights and repression text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (against, the, by, to, as, e.g.) in passages on state or employer repression, such as labor rights, human rights abuses and policing. It also fires on the hyphen in "Delayed-Release".

modes.label: Repression and rights passages
modes.description: Small linking words just before a description of suppression, discrimination or restriction by authorities or employers.
modes.example: protection<< against>> acts of anti-union discrimination

modes.description: The hyphen between Delayed and Release in a tablet name.
